user.title: Add your Volcano Hybrid
user.description: Pick the vaporizer you want to add. Only devices Home Assistant can currently see over Bluetooth are listed.

data_description.address: The Volcano Hybrid to control. If yours is missing, switch it on and wait a few seconds for it to advertise.

bluetooth_confirm.title: Add your Volcano Hybrid
bluetooth_confirm.description: Do you want to set up {name}?

options.title: Startup behaviour
options.description: Optional settings applied to {name} ({address}) whenever Home Assistant starts up or reloads this integration.

data_description.initial_temperature: Target temperature in °C written on startup, between {min_temp} and {max_temp}. Leave empty to keep whatever the device already has.
data_description.fan_on_connect: Run the fan when Home Assistant starts. This applies once per startup or reload, not on every Bluetooth reconnect.

error.cannot_connect: Could not connect. Make sure the vaporizer is switched on and is not already connected to the Storz & Bickel app.
error.not_in_range: The device is not currently visible to any Bluetooth adapter or proxy.

abort.not_supported: This Bluetooth device is not a Volcano Hybrid.

fan_timer.name: Fan timer
fan_timer.description: Runs the fan for a set time, then stops it.

duration.name: Duration
duration.description: How long to run the fan, in seconds.

turn_off_heat.name: Turn off heat
turn_off_heat.description: Also switch the heater off when the timer expires.

turn_off_screen.name: Turn off screen
turn_off_screen.description: Also switch the screen off when the timer expires.

screen_animation.name: Screen animation
screen_animation.description: Animates the screen brightness. Use the 'none' animation to stop and restore the default brightness.

cannot_connect.message: Could not connect to the Volcano Hybrid at {address}: {error}

not_in_range.message: The Volcano Hybrid at {address} is not visible to any Bluetooth adapter or proxy.

command_failed.message: The command could not be sent to the Volcano Hybrid: {error}

no_target.message: No Volcano Hybrid was found for this action.

entry_not_loaded.message: {target} is not loaded, so this action cannot run.
